caption:
Sleepmaxxing, fibremaxxing, looksmaxxing. Dictionary.com made "maxxing" its word of the year for 2026, and you can see why.

Bupa found 37% of UK adults feel pressured by these trends, and 31% say the content makes them more anxious about their health.

The habits with the best evidence are dull. They don't trend because nobody can sell them to you.

Which trend are you most tired of seeing?

Save this for the next time your feed makes you feel behind, and send it to the friend who has tried every trend this year.
